_comment: OpenRouter (default provider). The proxy advertises one model, aliased as claude-sonnet-5[1m] so Claude Code displays 'Sonnet 5' and uses a 1M context window; the real upstream is google/gemini-3.7-flash:nitro (throughput-optimized providers), whose native window is 1,048,576 tokens. The [1m] suffix is what lifts the client off its 200k default. CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW overrides the 500k auto-compact default Claude Code hardcodes for sonnet-5. Every model slot maps to the same upstream, images included. skipWebFetchPreflight keeps native WebFetch working behind the local proxy.
